contentText:
Open AI CEO Sam Altman does a television interview | Getty Images

Instagram is filled with people posting deepfaked content - including, as of late, from one of Meta's most prominent executives.

Earlier in November, Alexandr Wang, Meta's chief AI officer, shared a short clip to promote Muse, the company's consumer AI agent. In the AI-generated clip, Wang, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and Jolly, the anthropomorphic mascot of Muse, are on a four-way video call. When Altman joins the call he's dressed like Jolly, wearing a furry hooded suit and face paint to look like the cutesy character.
